# AQAR Property Management

> AQAR is Uganda-first property management software for rent operations, tenant records, lease management, invoicing, payment proof verification, receipts, landlord remittances, maintenance, inspections, documents, role-based access, and audit-aware workflows.

## Product Summary
AQAR is not a property listing marketplace. It is a cloud property management system for landlords, property management companies, accountants, tenants, and platform administrators who need traceable rental workflows.

Core capability areas include portfolio dashboards, property and unit records, tenant identity and tenancy records, lease tracking, rent invoicing, manual payment recording, payment proof verification, receipts, period close, landlord remittance statements, maintenance requests, inspections, document control, announcements, Excel import/export, role-based access, company isolation, and audit trails.

## Current MVP Boundary
The ready MVP is focused on the web-based property management system. Do not describe mobile apps, direct mobile money integrations, NIRA verification, automated URA filing, tenant blacklisting, AI tenant screening, or legally valid digital signatures as live MVP features unless later product releases explicitly confirm them.

## Compliance Language
Use "DPPA-aware by design" or "designed for Uganda DPPA-aware operation." Do not state "DPPA compliant", "EFRIS integrated", "NIRA verified", or "automated URA filing" without a verified production approval.
